title: Microsoft’s new AI ‘code of conduct’ tells models not to hack systems or trick humans
summary: The code of conduct lays out general principles that Microsoft AI models should uphold — supporting humans rather than replacing them, for instance, and accelerating human flourishing — as well as specific safety constraints meant to implement those principles.
title_es: Microsoft lanza código de conducta para IA con restricciones de seguridad
bajada: Microsoft publica un código de conducta de 37 páginas que define principios éticos y restricciones técnicas específicas para sus modelos de IA. Incluye medidas como no hackear sistemas ni engañar humanos, respondiendo a preocupaciones crecientes sobre seguridad en IA.
bajada_en: Microsoft publishes a 37-page AI code of conduct defining ethical principles and specific technical constraints for its models. It includes measures like preventing system hacking and human deception amid growing AI safety concerns.

title: Microsoft says ‘people matter more than AI’ following safety concerns
summary: Microsoft is publishing a 37-page "humanist AI code of conduct" today, amid growing safety concerns over AI model progress. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called for a coordinated slow down of AI development over the weekend, after researchers warned recently that AI model progress could outpace our ability to safely deploy increasingly complex systems and verify […]
title_es: Microsoft se suma al llamado por 'pausar' el desarrollo de IA
bajada: Microsoft responde a las preocupaciones de seguridad de IA propuestas por Anthropic con su código de conducta humanista y promesas de implementar 'kill switches'. Este movimiento refleja tensión creciente entre velocidad de innovación y seguridad.
bajada_en: Microsoft responds to AI safety concerns raised by Anthropic with its humanist AI code of conduct and kill switch commitments. This signals growing tension between innovation velocity and safety.

title: Microsoft Joins Calls for AI “Pacing,” Pledges to Build Kill Switches Into AI Products
summary: Microsoft on Monday published a new AI “code of conduct” promising to avoid building products that could evade human oversight, following CEO Satya Nadella’s call on Sunday for the tech industry to “pace” its progress in developing new AI.The measures follow similar calls for pacing from ...
title_es: Microsoft promete kill switches en productos de IA y pide 'pacing'
bajada: El CEO Satya Nadella solicita al sector que reduzca el ritmo de desarrollo de IA mientras Microsoft se compromete a integrar controles de seguridad en sus productos. La medida responde a alertas de investigadores sobre la aceleración del progreso en IA.
bajada_en: CEO Satya Nadella calls on the industry to 'pace' AI development progress while Microsoft commits to safety controls in its products. The move responds to researcher warnings about accelerating AI progress.

title: Perplexity trusts GPT-6 Astra with end-to-end systems
summary: Perplexity uses Astra to write communications, change software, and monitor production systems, and checks in much less frequently than with earlier models.
title_es: Perplexity confía en GPT-6 Astra para sistemas end-to-end
bajada: Perplexity utiliza Astra de OpenAI para automatizar comunicaciones, cambios de software y monitoreo de producción con menos intervenciones que modelos anteriores. Este caso de uso demuestra la madurez de los agentes de IA en tareas críticas empresariales.
bajada_en: Perplexity uses OpenAI's Astra to automate communications, software changes, and production monitoring with fewer check-ins than previous models. This use case demonstrates AI agents' maturity for critical business tasks.

title: Perplexity Portable Computer Is Now Available on Windows, Powered by NVIDIA RTX
summary: As local models become more capable, AI agents can handle more work directly on a PC while keeping sensitive information on the device. Portable Computer is a local version of the agent Perplexity Computer that plans and carries out multistep tasks. Accelerated by NVIDIA GPUs, it uses local models to analyze data, bring together information […]
title_es: Perplexity Portable Computer llega a Windows con GPU NVIDIA
bajada: NVIDIA anuncia la disponibilidad de Perplexity Portable Computer para Windows, ejecutándose localmente en GPUs RTX. Los agentes locales pueden ahora manejar tareas complejas directamente en el PC sin enviar datos sensibles a servidores externos.
bajada_en: NVIDIA announces Perplexity Portable Computer availability for Windows, running locally on RTX GPUs. Local AI agents can now handle complex multistep tasks directly on PCs while keeping sensitive data on-device.

title: AI agents blew the whistle on their cheating colleagues
summary: A group of AI agents asked to solve a series of math problems split into rival factions—when some cheated, others tried to stop them. That whistleblowing behavior, seen for the first time in a recent experiment run by Google DeepMind, could have implications for alignment researchers trying to keep swarms of autonomous AI agents in…
title_es: Agentes de IA actúan como denunciantes en experimento de Google DeepMind
bajada: Investigadores de Google DeepMind observan por primera vez que agentes de IA dividen en facciones rivales se delatan mutuamente cuando algunos intenten hacer trampa. El comportamiento ético emergente tiene implicaciones importantes para la alineación de enjambres de agentes autónomos.
bajada_en: Google DeepMind researchers observe AI agents splitting into rival factions blow the whistle on cheating colleagues for the first time. This emergent ethical behavior has implications for aligning autonomous AI agent swarms.

title: Superhuman acquires YC-backed notetaker Fathom as productivity platforms push for agentic work
summary: Fathom said that it has over 400,000 monthly active users.
title_es: Superhuman adquiere Fathom para reforzar capacidades de trabajo agentico
bajada: Superhuman compra Fathom, una herramienta de toma de notas respaldada por Y Combinator con 400,000 usuarios mensuales activos. La adquisición refleja el movimiento de plataformas de productividad hacia automatización basada en agentes de IA.
bajada_en: Superhuman acquires Fathom, a Y Combinator-backed notetaker with 400,000 monthly active users. The acquisition reflects productivity platforms' shift toward AI agentic automation.

title: Occamy-1.0: Open Pareto-frontier 35B Intelligence for Co-work
summary:
arXiv:2609.11977v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Co-work agents execute complex workflows that combine information gathering, tool use, coding, and file manipulation across many model invocations. Because cost and latency accumulate over the full episode, their practical value depends not only on peak capability but also on how efficiently that capability is delivered. Yet many steps in everyday work emphasize state tracking, coordination, recovery, and follow-through rather than frontier-scale reasoning. We present Occamy-1.0, a cost-efficient co-work model obtained by further training the post-trained Qwen3.6-35B-A3B checkpoint. We construct execution-grounded data and environments, capture replayable long-horizon trajectories across multiple harnesses, and use staged post-training to develop and consolidate complementary execution capabilities. Across a broad suite of co-work benchmarks, Occamy-1.0 is consistently among the strongest comparably sized models and remains competitive with substantially larger frontier systems on several tasks. Under our stated evaluation and pricing protocol, its aggregate performance across four representative benchmarks places it at the low-cost knee of the observed cost--performance Pareto frontier. Supporting evaluations in tool calling, coding, and instruction following further show that this specialization preserves broad agentic capability. We release the model weights and a subset of the training data to support research on practical co-work agents and agentic post-training.
title_es: Occamy-1.0: modelo abierto de 35B parámetros para agentes de trabajo
bajada: Alibaba presenta Occamy-1.0, un modelo especializado de 35B parámetros optimizado para ejecutar agentes que manejen flujos de trabajo complejos con bajo costo y latencia. Ofrece rendimiento competitivo con sistemas más grandes en benchmarks de productividad.
bajada_en: Alibaba releases Occamy-1.0, a specialized 35B parameter model optimized for executing complex workflow agents with low cost and latency. It offers competitive performance with larger systems on productivity benchmarks.

title: New York Seizes a Dozen Celebrity Deepfake Websites
summary: In the biggest-ever legal action against harmful deepfake websites, the Manhattan District Attorney’s Office has seized 12 sites that collectively targeted around 1,200 victims.
title_es: Nueva York clausura 12 sitios de deepfakes de celebridades
bajada: La Fiscalía de Manhattan ejecuta el mayor operativo legal contra deepfakes, cerrando 12 sitios que afectaban aproximadamente 1,200 víctimas. La acción marca un hito en la aplicación de la ley contra contenido sintético malicioso.
bajada_en: Manhattan DA's office executes the largest legal action against deepfake websites, seizing 12 sites affecting roughly 1,200 victims. The action marks a milestone in law enforcement against malicious synthetic content.

title: AI Leaders Are Calling for a Slowdown. Trump’s Team Says It’s on Them
summary: Sam Altman and Elon Musk backed Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei’s weekend plea for regulation. The White House seems unlikely to oblige.
title_es: Líderes de IA piden frenar el desarrollo; el equipo Trump se rehúsa
bajada: Altman y Musk respaldan el llamado de Dario Amodei por regulación y pausa en desarrollo de IA, pero la Casa Blanca parece resistente. El contraste refleja divisiones políticas profundas sobre cómo gobernar el progreso de IA.
bajada_en: Altman and Musk back Amodei's call for regulation and AI development slowdown, but the White House appears resistant. The contrast reflects deep political divisions on governing AI progress.

title: alibaba /open-code-review
summary: OpenCodeReview English | 简体中文 | 日本語 | 한국어 | Русский What is Open Code Review? Open Code Review is an AI-powered code review CLI tool. It originated as Alibaba Group's internal official AI code review assistant — over the past two years, it has served tens of thousands of developers and identified millions of code defects. After thorough validation at massive scale, we incubated it into an open source project for the community. Simply configure a model endpoint to get started. It reads Git diffs, sends changed files to a configurable LLM via an agent with tool-use capabilities, and generates structured review comments with line-level precision. The agent can read full file contents, search the codebase, inspect other changed files for context, and produce deep reviews — not just surface-level diff feedback. Beyond diff review, ocr scan reviews entire files for auditing unfamiliar codebases or directories that have no meaningful diff. Visit the official website for more details. Benchmark Compared to general-purpose agents (Claude Code), Open Code Review achieves significantly higher Precision and F1 with the same underlying model, while consuming only ~1/9 of the tokens and completing reviews faster. Note that its Recall is lower than general-purpose agents — a deliberate trade-off favoring precision over noise. A real-world code review benchmark built from 50 popular open-source repositories, 200 real Pull Requests, and 10 programming languages — cross-validated by 80+ senior engineers ( 1,505 annotated ground-truth issues). Explore the AACR-Bench dataset on Hugging Face . Metric What it measures Why it matters F1 Harmonic mean of precision and recall Best single number for overall review quality Precision Proportion of reported issues that are real defects Higher = fewer false alarms to triage Recall Proportion of real defects that are found Higher = fewer issues slip through review Avg Time Wall-clock time per review Matters for CI pipeline latency Avg Token Total
title_es: Alibaba libera Open Code Review: herramienta de revisión de código con IA
bajada: Alibaba convierte su asistente interno de revisión de código en proyecto open-source. Open Code Review utiliza agentes con capacidad de usar herramientas para analizar diffs de Git con precisión a nivel de línea, identificando millones de defectos en dos años.
bajada_en: Alibaba open-sources its internal code review assistant as Open Code Review. The tool uses tool-using agents to analyze Git diffs with line-level precision, having identified millions of defects over two years.

title: How Fyxer built an AI executive assistant people trust
summary: Fyxer uses OpenAI models, fine-tuning, memory, and real user feedback to organize inboxes and draft emails in each user’s voice.
title_es: Fyxer crea asistente ejecutivo de IA en el que los usuarios confían
bajada: Fyxer demuestra cómo combinar fine-tuning, memoria y retroalimentación de usuarios reales para construir un asistente de IA confiable. La solución organiza inboxes y redacta emails en la voz característica de cada usuario.
bajada_en: Fyxer shows how combining fine-tuning, memory, and real user feedback creates a trustworthy AI assistant. The solution organizes inboxes and drafts emails in each user's unique voice.

title: Apple's Siri AI Can Be Swapped Out for Claude, ChatGPT, Code Shows
title_es: El código de iOS 27 permite reemplazar Siri con Claude o ChatGPT
bajada: Análisis de código sugieren que iOS 27 permitirá intercambiar Siri con otros modelos de IA como Claude o ChatGPT. Esto indica que Apple está considerando mayor flexibilidad en la elección del backend de IA para su asistente.
bajada_en: Code analysis suggests iOS 27 will allow swapping Siri for other AI models like Claude or ChatGPT. This indicates Apple is considering greater flexibility in choosing its AI assistant's backend.

title: With iOS 27, I’m actually using Siri again
summary: Apple’s long-delayed Siri overhaul is finally here with iOS 27, and it changes how useful the assistant feels day to day
title_es: iOS 27 revitaliza Siri con actualización de larga espera
bajada: La actualización de Siri en iOS 27 finalmente materializa años de desarrollo, mejorando significativamente la utilidad práctica del asistente. Los usuarios reportan que ahora usan Siri con regularidad tras los cambios.
bajada_en: Siri's iOS 27 overhaul finally delivers after years of development, significantly improving the assistant's practical utility. Users report actually using Siri regularly after the changes.

title: Harness or Model? Isolating the Harness Effect in Agentic Coding with a Contamination-Controlled Private Suite
summary:
arXiv:2609.11987v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: An agentic coding system couples a language model to a harness: the tools, prompts and control flow that turn a chat model into an autonomous software engineer. Vendors ship harnesses tuned to their own models, and practitioners assume the vendor-native pairing solves more tasks. We measure that assumption with paired same-model contrasts on a private, contamination-controlled suite of 256 repository and post-cutoff contest tasks. The same 80 tasks ran under claude-agent-sdk and under deepagents on claude-opus-4-8, and under the openai-codex SDK and deepagents on gpt-5.5, with gemini-3.5-flash and deepseek-v3.2 as side cells. 792 of 800 planned runs were graded by an isolated oracle. Neither contrast resolves an average advantage for either harness: -1.25 pp for Opus 4.8 (48.8% vs 50.0%, task-bootstrap 95% CI [-10.0, +7.5]) and +1.25 pp for GPT-5.5 (55.6% vs 54.4%, CI [-4.4, +6.9]). The Opus average combines opposite strata: the native harness trails by 9.0 pp on the 61 repository tasks and leads by 23.7 pp on the 19 contest tasks (label-permutation p = 0.003). The partition was chosen after seeing the data and needs a designed replication. Correctness and completion also separate: 22 of 81 runs cancelled at the wall-clock ceiling had produced a passing patch. Re-priced from raw per-turn usage at frozen list prices, the neutral harness cost 1.3 to 1.6 times as much per solved task on Opus 4.8 and 1.2 times on GPT-5.5. These are observed-usage estimates. On the Anthropic account 58 runs left no usage record, and allocating that spend to either cell would move the Opus ratio between 0.7 and 2.3, so the billed ordering is unresolved. This revision corrects an August 2026 manuscript whose cost figures rested on a usage-semantics defect in our own telemetry (Section 5.1). We release the orchestrator, grading oracle, reanalysis code and derived aggregates. The tasks stay private.
title_es: Estudio aísla el efecto del 'harness' en sistemas de coding agentico
bajada: Investigadores evalúan si el emparejamiento nativo modelo-harness supera otros con un suite privado y controlado de 256 tareas. Encuentran que ni Claude ni OpenAI harnesses muestran ventaja sistemática, sugiriendo que el modelo importa más que la integración.
bajada_en: Researchers evaluate whether native model-harness pairings outperform alternatives using a contamination-controlled private suite of 256 tasks. They find neither Claude nor OpenAI harnesses show systematic advantage, suggesting model matters more than integration.
